name: print-social-deep-green-3d-logo-tile-decentralization-slide
title: Deep Green 3D Logo Tile Slide
whatItIs: A deep green portrait slide with mint zigzag bands, a glossy 3D rounded-square tile holding the brand mark in the centre, a large white heading 'Decentralization of Control & Fairness' with 'Fairness' in mint, a centred paragraph and a small arrow tile at the top right.
whatItMeans: A single rendered logo tile gives a solid focal point in a flat graphic system, and white on deep green feels serious.
techniques: 3D extruded logo tile as the hero
White heading with one mint word
Small arrow tile as a slide cue

vocabulary.definition: A word in a second colour within a heading.
A small icon hinting at the next slide.
